comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: One thing I'd love to understand better is how Saba's economy works without the crowds of mass tourism found on larger Caribbean islands. What kinds of jobs support most local families, and how important are public services, small businesses, and nature-based tourism? Does the island's small population make everyday goods and housing more expensive than visitors might expect?

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Living in Saba must feel like being part of one big family, surrounded by mountains, ocean views, and a slower pace of life. I'm fascinated by how residents balance island traditions with the challenges of living somewhere so isolated. I'd love to spend a few days getting to know this community.
